title: Release quest-cli 0.3.4
description: User-approved (2026-09-05, AskUserQuestion) to carry QCLI-235 (opum-quest plugin scaffold) and QCLI-236 (skill_source=plugin opt-out) to a git tag opum-agent can pin the marketplace entry to, and to give the fleet's other repos --skill-source/--force. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md and the QCLI-234 (0.3.3) precedent exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Root package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, optionalDependencies, and the conformance fixture bumped to 0.3.4 and committed together with freshly-built (Bun 1.3.14) platform packages, bun.lock regenerated in the same commit this time (QCLI-234 missed this and it only surfaced after publish)
v0.3.4 tag pushed and prepublication-qualification.yml dispatched against it; native-execution receipt downloaded and bun run receipt:require passes
release.yml dispatched with publish=false (dry run) then publish=true against v0.3.4, gated on the receipt - publish=true is the one step requiring the repo's own user's direct, immediate go-ahead
Post-publish clean-install smoke passes against the published registry artifacts, including quest agents --skill-source and --force end to end
bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the six published platform tarballs
docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md gets a new dated section for 0.3.4
dev promoted to main (fast-forward, required checks green on the exact SHA) either before or immediately after publish
.claude-plugin/plugin.json's version matches 0.3.4; report the exact tag and commit SHA to opum-agent once published so the opum-quest marketplace entry can pin to it

implementationNotes: AC1: bumped all hand-edited locations including .claude-plugin/plugin.json this time (new since 0.3.3). Regenerated bun.lock proactively via bun install before committing - confirmed the wanted-version declaration updates correctly (optionalDependencies now say 0.3.4), but the six platform packages' resolved package-table entries stay absent until they're actually publishable (bun does not eagerly re-resolve previously-unresolvable optional deps even after clearing its cache and reinstalling fresh with no node_modules - tested this explicitly post-publish). This did not block anything: CI's real bun install --frozen-lockfile step passed cleanly in the actual qualification run against exactly this state, proving the declared-version-only lockfile is sufficient for the frozen-lockfile gate regardless of full resolution-table completeness.

AC2: tagged v0.3.4 at a50da3c, dispatched prepublication-qualification.yml explicitly against the tag (run 33985711996). All six platform jobs passed, including bun install --frozen-lockfile succeeding (confirms the proactive lockfile fix worked, unlike 0.3.3 where this same step failed on the dev->main PR). Receipt gated: 'Native-execution receipt binds 0.3.4 at a50da3c across all six platforms', exit 0.

AC3: dry run (release.yml publish=false, run 33986061598) succeeded. User gave explicit go-ahead via AskUserQuestion immediately before the real dispatch. Real publish (run 33987103879): Publish and Verify both green. npm view @opum-ai/quest version confirms 0.3.4 independently.

AC4: fresh isolated npm install of @opum-ai/quest@0.3.4. Full --skill-source/--force flow verified end to end against the published bytes: init --agent-instructions --target claude --skill-source plugin persists config and writes the skill once; bare agents --update-instructions then reports it orphaned; agents --check exits 6; agents --update-instructions --force removes the byte-exact file; agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0 afterward. Also confirmed quest-web's independently-reported AGENTS.md-hardcoding defect in the per-repo skill text is already fixed in this release (QCLI-236's fix; they tested against pre-fix 0.3.3).
AC5: bun run receipt:verify-published -- 0.3.4 reported 'Receipt matches every platform package published as 0.3.4', exit 0.

AC6: added 'Current publication state (2026-09-05, updated for 0.3.4)' and a full '0.3.4 release' section to docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md with SHA/npm shasum/integrity tables, qualification run links, receipt binding, and post-publish smoke results. lore check clean.

AC7: promoted dev to main BEFORE the publish dispatch this time (PR #274, both required checks green on the exact SHA, git push origin dev:main, verified main==dev afterward) - deliberately reordered from the 0.3.3 sequence per the orchestrator's stated fleet rule and the lesson from the bun.lock incident (the gate that could fail now fires before the irreversible step, not after).

AC8: .claude-plugin/plugin.json's version bumped to 0.3.4 in the same commit as the CLI version. Will report the exact tag (v0.3.4) and commit SHA (a50da3c) to opum-agent now that publish is confirmed, so the opum-quest marketplace entry can pin to it.
finalSummary: Released @opum-ai/quest 0.3.4, carrying QCLI-235 (opum-quest plugin scaffold) and QCLI-236 (skill_source=plugin opt-out with --force). Followed the runbook exactly, with one deliberate change from the 0.3.3 sequence: promoted dev to main BEFORE the publish dispatch this time (not after), per the lesson that surfaced from 0.3.3's post-publish bun.lock fix - the gate now fires before the irreversible step. Regenerated bun.lock proactively before committing (declared-version correct; full resolution-table population for optional platform deps turns out not to be achievable locally even post-publish, but CI's real frozen-lockfile check already proved this doesn't matter for the actual gate). Independently verified from outside the workflow: npm shows 0.3.4 live; a from-scratch isolated install proved the full --skill-source/--force opt-out flow end to end against the published bytes; receipt:verify-published matched all six platform tarballs; dev/main confirmed identical post-promotion. Updated docs/reference/quest-cli-release-truth.md with full evidence, lore check clean. Tag v0.3.4 at commit a50da3c, reporting both to opum-agent for the opum-quest marketplace pin.
